issue.title: Exception java.util.ServiceConfigurationError thrown
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
In certain cases, tests throw an exception before being executed
```
java.util.ServiceConfigurationError: io.smallrye.config.SmallRyeConfigFactory: io.quarkus.runtime.configuration.QuarkusConfigFactory not a subtype
```

**Expected behavior**
The test can be run.

**Actual behavior**
An exception is thrown during the test initialization.

**To Reproduce**
Test available with PR #9274

**Environment (please complete the following information):**
 - Quarkus version or git rev: `1.4.2.Final`

body:
If I sometimes(periodically) get 
`Caused by: java.util.ServiceConfigurationError: io.smallrye.config.SmallRyeConfigFactory: io.quarkus.runtime.configuration.QuarkusConfigFactory not a subtype
`  with 1.5.0 Final does it sound like a legitimate problem?

> If I sometimes(periodically) get
> `Caused by: java.util.ServiceConfigurationError: io.smallrye.config.SmallRyeConfigFactory: io.quarkus.runtime.configuration.QuarkusConfigFactory not a subtype ` with 1.5.0 Final does it sound like a legitimate problem?

Same here with 1.5.2
Not sure if there has been a regression here or something else is at play but I'm now seeing this error having moved a project up from 1.4.2 to 1.8.1 Final.
I am receiving this issue with 1.13.1.Final.  In my case it is triggered trying to load the JwtEncryptionBuilder class which is part of quarkus-smallrye-jwt-build.

I had the same error when testing with a Main application that involves parallel().stream().
If I remove parallel(), then test does its work without exceptions.
PS Launching the main from quarkus:dev() return me no error

issue.title: Getting io.quarkus.runtime.configuration.QuarkusConfigFactory not a subtype in dev mode really intermitently
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

This one is really hard to reproduce, it seems to happen randomly, and so far I have been able to observe it only in dev mode. I will not be able to put a reproducer in place as I am really not able to reproduce at will.

Here's the stacktrace;

```
2022-03-10 22:11:00,269 ERROR [org.qua.cor.ErrorLogger] (QuarkusQuartzScheduler_Worker-8) Job (io.quarkus.scheduler.Scheduler.scheduler-poller-job threw an exception.: org.quartz.SchedulerException: Job threw an unhandled exception. Please note;
```
1. Event is coming as a List<Event> from a rest client reactive jackson
2. first line of the stackStrace, the isValid, contains this; `Config config = Arc.container().instance(Config.class).get();`
2.1 **Could this be an issue running that in a parallelStream?** if yes, what could be my alternative?
4. isValid is called from a list.parallelStream().forEach() Where all items are unique
5. the parallelStream() is called within a quartz `@Scheduled` method

is seems consistent with @fstarred comments https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/9273#issuecomment-1059336625 and https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/8210#issuecomment-1059222354 but in his case it seems to say that the dev mode is fine, which is not my case.

I wonder if this can happen with the jar or native. As it is really hard to repro, I cannot say if **only** devmode is affected, but so far it is the only place I could see it.

No Exceptions are thrown and processing goes through
